The projects include; 3- Kilometres behind Azbir Hotel, 3- Kilometres behind Texaco filling station, and the upgrading of the old road from the Divisional Police Office to Nagari College all in Birnin Kebbi local government metropolis.
During the flagging off of the projects at the respective locations, Governor Nasir Idris described the projects as a fulfilment of his administration’s promises to the people during his governorship aspiration campaign in 2023.
He also promised to continue to deliver more developmental projects that will benefit the communities across the state. He called on the contractors handling the projects to ensure they produced a qualitative job as stipulated in the contract agreement between them and the government.

Wurma is a Reporter with Leadership Newspaper in Birnin Kebbi, Kebbi State, with a journalism career spanning nearly three decades. A graduate of Bayero University, Kano, with a BA in Hausa and Mass Communication, he has reported for Katsina Newsweek, Today Newspaper, New Nigerian Newspapers, Vanguard, and The Sun before joining Leadership in 2020. He is the current Chairman of the Correspondents' Chapel of the Nigeria Union of Journalists (NUJ), Kebbi State, and is the author of two Hausa-language books — Alheri Gadon Barci (2013) and Wayar Salula, Muhimmancinta da Aibinta ga Al'umma (2015).
